code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

IP::ingress_drop_rate
       Adds ip with specified drop rate to black list table.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       This command adds ip with specified drop rate to black list table, table enforced per packet containing source ip for
       specified timeout.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
